description.zh: pH = −log₁₀[H⁺]：把酸碱程度排成 0–14 的对数刻度，每差 1 个单位 [H⁺] 相差 10 倍；指示剂按各自的 pH 范围变色，酸怎么稀释也只会趋近 7。仅适用于 25 ℃ 的强酸强碱水溶液模型。
description.en: pH = −log₁₀[H⁺]: acidity on a 0–14 logarithmic ruler where each unit is a factor of 10 in [H⁺]; indicators change colour within their own pH ranges, and diluting an acid only approaches 7. Valid for strong acids and bases in water at 25 °C.

reason.zh: pH 取氢离子浓度的负对数，所以刻度上差 1 对应浓度差 10 倍，差 3 对应 1000 倍。
reason.en: pH is the negative logarithm of the hydrogen ion concentration, so a difference of 1 on the ruler is a factor of 10 in concentration and a difference of 3 is a factor of 1000.

title.zh: pH 差 3 到底差多少倍？
title.en: How many times stronger is an acid 3 pH units lower?
